correctness.rationale: Condition on the unordered value set A in the first i positions. The conditional mean of R_i is always 1/i. If j is in the suffix, S_j depends only on the suffix order; if j is in A but a smaller value is outside A, S_j is identically zero. Otherwise all values up to j lie in A, and the position of the maximum of A is independent of their induced order unless A=[j] and i=j. In that exceptional case both indicators equal the indicator of pi_i=i, with variance (i-1)/i^2, and the prefix set has probability 1/binom(n,i). Total covariance now gives the exact kernel; the Bernoulli marginals give the stated joint law and off-diagonal independence. For the total covariance, i=n, n-1 and 2 give 1/n-1/n^2, 1/n^2+O(n^-3) and 1/(2n^2)+O(n^-3). The exceptional near-end terms i=3,n-2,n-3 are O(n^-3) individually, and the middle range is at most n/binom(n,4). The independent uniform successive relative ranks give the marginal variance H_n-H_n^(2), hence the correlation asymptotic. The deterministic first indicators and n=2 are consistent with the formula.
residual_risks: Exhaustive checks through n=8 are recorded only and were not rerun. The proof is for uniform permutations and not for forward/inverse joint independence or biased laws.
